calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the cross-sectional mean log return to obtain residual return. Reverse the lagged 10-session residual move, scale by lagged 40-session downside residual volatility, and amplify it when the smoothed cross-asset downside-tail breadth is elevated. Cross-sectional percentile ranks are smoothed over three sessions and demeaned. All rolling inputs and the signal are lagged before forward-return testing.

validation.regime_notes: Passes benchmark gates on the available 15-asset cross-section. Full-sample ICIR is supported by strong recent performance (365-session ICIR 0.332568; 750-session ICIR 0.117522), while the 1260-session ICIR is 0.082002. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because average coverage is 10.24 instruments.
